title: Also Done
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：also　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 also 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Also, in 1963 the postman helped the envelope at the box, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the postman had ② also helped the envelope, and nobody had asked a single question. The postman had come to the office two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The list for June 1957 puts it plainer. The envelope was ③ also useful, and the sender who kept it had ④ also fetched it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done also in those days. The sender wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else. He helped the envelope ⑤ also year after year, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who helped it that week, he helped it ⑥ also twice over. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the envelope be fetched ⑦ also every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ also careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done also.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973 she helped the envelope  also twice over when nobody else would, and  Also, she said in 1975, that was the part the office never forgot; the list still speaks also of it. She kept the envelope in the same box for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how also it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 也（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had also helped …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 也（修饰形容词：also useful）
C. adv. 同样（评注性状语，置于句首：Also, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 同样（修饰过去分词：had also fetched it）
E. adv. 也（句末状语：… also year after year）
F. adv. 也（句末状语：… also twice over，第 6 处）
G. adv. 同样（被动结构中的中位状语：be fetched also）
H. adv. 同样（修饰形容词：be also careful about the whole business）

items.q: also year after year, and nobody

answers.why: also 意为“也”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Also, in 1963 …。
also 意为“也”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had also helped the envelope。
also 意为“也”，此处修饰形容词 useful（有用）：was also useful。
also 意为“同样”，此处修饰过去分词 fetched：had also fetched it twice。
also 意为“也”，此处置于句末修饰动词：helped the envelope also year after year。
also 意为“也”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it also twice over。
also 意为“同样”，被动结构 be fetched also 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
also 意为“同样”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be also careful about the whole business。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，邮差同样在信箱帮忙那件薄薄的信封；邮局里人人都说那是头一回。（Also, …）
雨季到来之前，邮差已经也帮忙那件薄薄的信封。（had also helped …）
那件薄薄的信封当时也有用。（also useful）
保管它的那位寄信人在入冬前已经同样把它取过两回。（had also fetched it）
叔叔也帮忙那件薄薄的信封，邮局里没有一个人怀疑。（… also …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最也。（the most also of all of them）
